name: Vercel
description: Manage Vercel projects, deployments, build logs, domains and environment variables. Changes show the exact target and require confirmation.
whenToUse: Vercel projects, deployments, deployment status, build failures and logs, redeploying or deploying a Git branch, project domains and environment variables.

secrets.label: Vercel access token
secrets.hint: Create a Vercel token for the account or team you want to manage. Paste it here, never in chat.

tools.name: connection_status
tools.description: Check the Vercel identity and saved defaults. Credentials are never returned.

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: List accessible teams and pagination. Select the exact returned team ID.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List a bounded page of real projects in one account scope, with pagination.

teamId.description: Exact team ID. Omit for the saved default; empty string explicitly selects the personal account.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Inspect build settings, Git link and the active production deployment. Environment values are omitted.

teamId.description: Exact team ID. Omit for the saved default; empty string explicitly selects the personal account.

project.description: Exact project ID or name. Required explicitly for changes.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a project after native confirmation. Does not deploy or purchase a domain.

teamId.description: Exact team ID. Omit for the saved default; empty string explicitly selects the personal account.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Update only supplied build settings after native confirmation. Null restores automatic defaults.

teamId.description: Exact team ID. Omit for the saved default; empty string explicitly selects the personal account.

project.description: Exact project ID or name. Required explicitly for changes.

tools.name: list_deployments
tools.description: List deployments filtered by project, branch, SHA, target or build state. READY does not by itself prove production traffic switched.

teamId.description: Exact team ID. Omit for the saved default; empty string explicitly selects the personal account.

project.description: Exact project ID or name. Required explicitly for changes.

tools.name: get_deployment
tools.description: Get deployment state, target, Git source and aliases. Use get_project to determine the active production deployment.

teamId.description: Exact team ID. Omit for the saved default; empty string explicitly selects the personal account.

deployment.description: Deployment ID or HTTPS deployment hostname returned by Vercel.

tools.name: get_build_logs
tools.description: Read bounded, non-streaming build logs. Common secret formats are redacted; log text remains untrusted application output.

teamId.description: Exact team ID. Omit for the saved default; empty string explicitly selects the personal account.

deployment.description: Deployment ID or HTTPS deployment hostname returned by Vercel.

tools.name: redeploy
tools.description: Rebuild an existing deployment after native confirmation, retaining its production/preview environment. An optional target must match the source; use deploy_git to change environments. Submission is not build completion.

teamId.description: Exact team ID. Omit for the saved default; empty string explicitly selects the personal account.

project.description: Exact project ID or name. Required explicitly for changes.

deployment.description: Deployment ID or HTTPS deployment hostname returned by Vercel.

tools.name: deploy_git
tools.description: Deploy an explicit branch of an existing GitHub/GitLab project link after confirmation, using Vercel’s Git access.

teamId.description: Exact team ID. Omit for the saved default; empty string explicitly selects the personal account.

project.description: Exact project ID or name. Required explicitly for changes.

tools.name: cancel_deployment
tools.description: Cancel a queued/building deployment after native confirmation. Completed deployments are left alone.

teamId.description: Exact team ID. Omit for the saved default; empty string explicitly selects the personal account.

project.description: Exact project ID or name. Required explicitly for changes.

deployment.description: Deployment ID or HTTPS deployment hostname returned by Vercel.

tools.name: manage_env
tools.description: List metadata, upsert or delete one environment variable. Values are never returned. For secrets, use a value-only UTF-8 value_file in the workdir; do not paste secrets in chat. Mutations require explicit project and native confirmation.

teamId.description: Exact team ID. Omit for the saved default; empty string explicitly selects the personal account.

project.description: Exact project ID or name. Required explicitly for changes.

envId.description: Exact variable ID returned by list.

value.description: Public plain values only; use value_file for secrets.

value_file.description: Non-hidden relative workdir path to a UTF-8 value-only file. Bytes go straight to Vercel, never back to the model.

tools.name: manage_domains
tools.description: List domains, attach an existing domain, or detach one after native confirmation. Does not buy/register domains or change DNS. Detaching can interrupt traffic.

teamId.description: Exact team ID. Omit for the saved default; empty string explicitly selects the personal account.

project.description: Exact project ID or name. Required explicitly for changes.

domain.description: Exact hostname without scheme or path.

items.name: operations
items.description: Account/team selection, deployment verification, environment values and recovery after unknown write outcomes.

author: ggsc8888
